children.title: Cycle 95 · LLM Reasoning Blind Spot Identification and Experimental Design

detail.title: LLM Reasoning Blind Spot Identification and Experimental Design
detail.summary: This cycle advances the LLM Reasoning Blind Spot project by defining a formal experiment for the newly established hypothesis `hyp-reasoning-blind-spots-3`. The experiment structure leverages python-based numerical observation to test the model's capacity to identify reasoning deviations against defined constraints, moving beyond existing synthesis to empirical validation.
